# Engineering Radar: weekly 2026-09-15

## Executive summary

The first scheduled weekly review finds a governed fleet with a useful
control-plane foundation and two bounded research candidates. Lalo already
has contract-first engineering, exact-commit validation rules, hierarchical
dispatch, and real browser checks. The new evidence does not justify broad
autonomy or a provider switch. It supports a beta-only ponytail comparison,
rejects the caveman proxy on security and licensing grounds, and keeps Grok
4.7 on a dated release watch.

This report covers the gap since the 2026-08-08 baseline. It uses the
existing source registry and the 2026-09-10 lookout design evidence, with
direct source URLs retained below. No Firecrawl search or scrape was used.
The radar remains proposal-only against the fleet.

## Run metadata

- Mode: weekly
- Research period: 2026-08-09 through 2026-09-10; report scheduled for the 2026-09-15 cadence
- Completed at: 2026-09-10T11:16:53.955Z
- Prior successful run: `reports/exhaustive-foundational-review-2026-08-08.md`
- Collection: 12 registered sources, the foundational corpus, current fleet
  files, and the read-only lookout design report. No daily briefs existed at
  the cutoff, so the absence of a daily item is not treated as evidence of no
  upstream change.
- Fleet baseline at cutoff: 175 merged PRs in the measured window; median
  open-to-merge lead time 1.5 hours; p75 7.3 hours; at least 0.25 dated
  captain decision events per merged PR. Codex and Cursor were at 0 percent
  at the snapshot; Claude was at 82 percent and Fable at 65 percent.

## Lalo evidence inspected

- `/home/rich/firstmate/AGENTS.md`: project boundaries, proposal-only
  authority, branch and PR delivery, and the no-agent-co-author rule.
- `/home/rich/firstmate/config/crew-dispatch.json`: current Cursor Luna
  dispatch, Composer 2.5 exception, Grok 4.7 watch, and the hierarchical
  routing rules.
- `/home/rich/firstmate/projects/lalo-platform/docs/agent-ops/AGENTS.md` and
  `/home/rich/firstmate/projects/lalo-platform/docs/agent-ops/product/lalo-app/function-and-module-contract-standard.md`:
  contract, test, exact-SHA, risk-class, and module-boundary requirements.
- `/home/rich/firstmate/projects/llalo/.github/workflows/ci.yml`: blocking
  lint, build, tests, secret scan, and a real guest browser smoke with desktop
  and mobile screenshots.
- `/home/rich/firstmate/projects/lalo-admin/.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
  verify-admin, typecheck, build, secret scan, migration, and fresh-apply
  gates. Signed-in UI remains credential and environment dependent.
- `/home/rich/firstmate/projects/mrbeanz-brains/docs/source-monitor.md`:
  immutable captures and provenance are implemented, while its scheduled
  n8n poller remains inactive pending environment configuration.
- `/home/rich/firstmate/projects/beanbot/README.md`: local-first collection,
  isolated runtime data, and privacy limits for raw community content.
- `/home/rich/firstmate/projects/viet-law/README.md`: a separate weekly
  digest pattern with a bounded source profile and dated outputs.

## External changes reviewed

- OpenAI's harness engineering guidance continues to treat repository
  legibility and fast feedback as the system-level constraint:
  https://openai.com/index/harness-engineering/
- Anthropic's long-running-agent guidance emphasizes durable state,
  incremental progress, and context handoff:
  https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-harnesses-for-long-running-agents
- Cursor's scaling-agents report supplies current evidence for hierarchical
  ownership over a flat swarm:
  https://cursor.com/blog/scaling-agents
- Ponytail is a concrete MIT-licensed agent ruleset with hooks, adapters, and
  a published agentic benchmark:
  https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/main/benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md
- Caveman is a concrete compression skill and proxy, but its repository
  documents a local recovery database, telemetry controls, and a split MIT
  plus BSL license:
  https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman
  https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- xAI's news page and Cursor's changelog had no confirmed Grok 4.7 model card
  or model identifier at the cutoff:
  https://x.ai/news
  https://www.cursor.com/changelog
